pros: Generous limit: the 2025 course stayed open until 8.15am
Short loops through Sala with water stations passed in both directions
Entry fees fund a school-building project
Suits first-timers, families and company teams
cons: Near-saturated air: 94% to 100% humidity on the 2025 race morning
No refunds, and transfers close weeks before race day
The 21 km is new for 2026, with no past edition to judge it by
name: Gemadept Run HCMC 2026
short_description: Gemadept Run HCMC 2026 is on Sunday 25 October 2026 at the Sala urban area in Ho Chi Minh City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Gemadept Run HCMC 2026 is the second of two races in the fifth Gemadept Run season, organised by port and logistics company Gemadept, after a 5 km and 10 km race in Hai Phong on 10 October. Race day is Sunday 25 October 2026, with the expo on Saturday 24 October, at the Sala urban area. This is the first season in which the 5 km, 10 km and 21 km are all offered together.

core_facts.venue: Sala urban area, An Loi Dong ward
core_facts.organizer: Gemadept Corporation (Cong ty Co phan Gemadept)

faqs.question: What time does the 21 km start at Gemadept Run HCMC 2026?
faqs.answer: Gemadept's site lists a planned 3.30am start for the 21 km with a four-hour finishing window. The 10 km is planned for 5.15am with 2 hours 15 minutes, and the 5 km for 5.45am with 1 hour 45 minutes. The race also supports programmes for disadvantaged children.

faqs.question: Where is Gemadept Run HCMC 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The iRace event page lists the Sala urban area in An Loi Dong ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City. Race kits are collected on Saturday 24 October, the expo day before the race. Gemadept's own race site gives the location only as Ho Chi Minh City.
